articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Ondo Finance weighs acquisition worth up to $500 million
articles.snippet: The tokenized-assets firm is considering an acquisition valued at $250 million to $500 million as consolidation accelerates across crypto infrastructure.

articles.title: CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
articles.snippet: CME CEO Terry Duffy said a court battle over whether perpetual futures are swaps or futures could eventually affect how the IRS taxes the contracts. Independent legal experts say the issue remains unresolved.

articles.title: The economics behind Aave proposal to ditch 6 chains that earn loose change in revenue
articles.snippet: A governance proposal would shut deployments on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, and retire 50 asset markets elsewhere. Deposits on some have fallen more than 90%.

articles.title: JPMorgan says fading Clarity Act odds weigh on crypto outlook
articles.snippet: The bank said deteriorating prospects for U.S. market structure legislation remove a key catalyst for digital assets, even as tokenization and institutional adoption advance.
